description: The Submission Validator Drift Check workflow has failed on every run since 2026-07-06 (last green run 28762019048 @ 9f682a22d). The gate compares .github/workflows/validate-submission.yml between develop and the published-results branch and fails when they diverge. Evidence from run 30461875061 @ fe2c1b83d: published-results is STALE relative to develop on three hunks -- it lacks the --no-renames flag on both git diff invocations, lacks the .applied.json exclusion in the CHANGED filter, and is missing the entire CHANGED_APPLIED applied-ledger companion detection block added by #1334. Develop is authoritative for all three; published-results simply never received the forward-port. This item was filed after a session confirmed no existing tracker item covers it: submit-manifest-and-validator is about the submission MANIFEST schema (funding/result_source, vendor labels) scoped to submit.py and scripts/validate_submission.py, and release-canary-ruleset-drift-baseline-refresh is an unrelated drift gate.
